assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls AddServerSideSessions() on the IdentityServer builder chain
assertions.rationale: The builder chain includes .AddServerSideSessions() prior to .AddOperationalStore().

assertions.assertion: Program.cs configures AddOperationalStore with UseSqlServer using the connection string from configuration
assertions.rationale: AddOperationalStore's ConfigureDbContext calls db.UseSqlServer(connectionString) with the configuration-sourced connection string.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs does not rely on the default in-memory session store for production use
assertions.rationale: The response replaces the in-memory default with a SQL Server-backed operational store and notes it is production-safe.
